payload.posture: Read Acts 2:42–47 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states those added continue in apostolic teaching and fellowship, break bread, pray, share property according to need, gather at the temple and homes, and are joined by others. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
payload.title: Teaching, fellowship, meals, prayers, signs, and shared goods mark the community
